title: Melaleuca alternifolia tea for medicinal use
intro: Melaleuca alternifolia tea is a herbal preparation made from the leaves of the tea tree, which is native to Australia. It is known for its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, making it a popular choice in herbal medicine. This tea is often used to support respiratory health, soothe sore throats, and promote skin healing. It can also be applied topically to treat minor wounds or skin infections. In herbalism, it is valued for its natural cleansing and healing benefits.
